description:
If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping. 
If you have large amounts, special shipping will be necessary. 
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them. 
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used. 
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary. 
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen. 
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Shipping"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="Invitation to make an offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Shipping offer"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ShippingProcess" name="Shipping process" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsCompany1" name="Logistic company 1"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsCompany2" name="Logistic company 2"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsCompany3" name="Logistic company 3"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation1" name="Invitation" sourceRef="Task_Invite1" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany1" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation2" name="Invitation" sourceRef="Task_Invite2" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany2" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation3" name="Invitation" sourceRef="Task_Invite3" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany3" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer1" name="Offer" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany1" targetRef="Event_Offer1" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer2" name="Offer" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany2" targetRef="Event_Offer2" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer3" name="Offer" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany3" targetRef="Event_Offer3" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Arrange goods shipment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Shipping" name="Shipping process starts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShipGoods" name="Goods to be shipped?" default="Flow_NoShipping"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoShipping" name="Goods not shipped"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ConcurrentWork_Split" name="Proceed with arrangements and packaging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipping" name="Secretary clarifies who will do the shipping"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Amount" name="Large amount?" default="Flow_SmallAmount"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Invitations_Split" name="Invite three logistic companies"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Invite1" name="Invite logistic company 1 to make an offer" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Invite2" name="Invite logistic company 2 to make an offer" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Invite3" name="Invite logistic company 3 to make an offer" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Invitations_Join" name="Invitations sent"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Offers_Split" name="Wait for offers"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Offer1" name="Offer from logistic company 1">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Offer1" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Offer2" name="Offer from logistic company 2">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Offer2" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Offer3" name="Offer from logistic company 3">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Offer3" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Offers_Join" name="Offers received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Secretary selects a logistic company"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Use normal post shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShippingMethod_Merge" name="Shipping method selected"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteLabel" name="Secretary writes a package label"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Insurance" name="Parcel insurance necessary?" default="Flow_NoInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Logistics department head takes parcel insurance"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Insurance_Merge" name="Insurance decision complete"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Warehousemen package the goods"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Join" name="Shipping arrangements and packaging ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by the logistic company"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ShippingReady" name="Goods prepared for pickup"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ShipDecision" sourceRef="StartEvent_Shipping" targetRef="Gateway_ShipGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipGoods" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWork_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${goodsShallBeShipped}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoShipping" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipGoods" targetRef="EndEvent_NoShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Concurrent_ToClarify" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWork_Split" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Concurrent_ToPackage" sourceRef="Gateway_ConcurrentWork_Split" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Clarify_Amount" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipping" targetRef="Gateway_Amount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LargeAmount" name="Large amount" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Gateway_Invitations_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amountIsLarge}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SmallAmount" name="Small amount" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_NormalPost"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteSplit_1" sourceRef="Gateway_Invitations_Split" targetRef="Task_Invite1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteSplit_2" sourceRef="Gateway_Invitations_Split" targetRef="Task_Invite2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteSplit_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Invitations_Split" targetRef="Task_Invite3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite1_Join" sourceRef="Task_Invite1" targetRef="Gateway_Invitations_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite2_Join" sourceRef="Task_Invite2" targetRef="Gateway_Invitations_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite3_Join" sourceRef="Task_Invite3" targetRef="Gateway_Invitations_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_Offers" sourceRef="Gateway_Invitations_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Offers_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OffersSplit_1" sourceRef="Gateway_Offers_Split" targetRef="Event_Offer1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OffersSplit_2" sourceRef="Gateway_Offers_Split" targetRef="Event_Offer2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OffersSplit_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Offers_Split" targetRef="Event_Offer3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer1_Join" sourceRef="Event_Offer1" targetRef="Gateway_Offers_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer2_Join" sourceRef="Event_Offer2" targetRef="Gateway_Offers_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offer3_Join" sourceRef="Event_Offer3" targetRef="Gateway_Offers_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Select" sourceRef="Gateway_Offers_Join" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_ShippingMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingMethod_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Post_ShippingMerge" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingMethod_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingMerge_Label" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingMethod_Merge" targetRef="Task_WriteLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Label_Insurance" sourceRef="Task_WriteLabel" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${insuranceIsNecessary}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInsurance" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeInsurance_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Package_Ready" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready_Prepare" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Join" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_End" sourceRef="Task_PreparePickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ShippingReady"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
